fast_scope: active task-trained backend BN affine plus online auxiliary BN affine
inner_optimizer: one stateless SGD step per original audio
target_during_task: fixed; eval BN; no gradient or EMA
source_val_subset_rule: first 128 IDs per canonical class in sorted sample_id order; fixed across variants and epochs
checkpoint_selection: minimum source_val K1 EER; earliest epoch on exact ties
